publication_note: Canonical identifiers added after completion; measurements and the original tool hash are unchanged. git_sha records the branch head at campaign start, before the tool commit.

protocol.grid: 3x3 centers at 20/50/80 percent, 128x128 samples per Bayer plane
protocol.plane_order: row-major visible 2x2 CFA pattern, recorded for every source
protocol.reference_split: even/odd frame indices within each burst, diagnostic only
limitations: Motion and illumination changes contribute to temporal dispersion.
No production black/white calibration; reported white is informational only.
No clean target, local-motion validation, training or model selection.
All ISO variants of each composition must remain in the same neural partition.
